
```{python}
#imports
import polars as pl
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
```

```{python}
#load training data
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/master/data/bikes.csv"
bikes_df = pl.read_csv(url)

# Feature list
features = [
    "hr", "temp_c", "feels_like_c", "hum",
    "windspeed", "weathersit", "season", "holiday", "workingday"
]

# Select features + targets
X = bikes_df.select(features)
y = bikes_df.select(["registered", "casual"])

# Convert to numpy
X_np = X.to_numpy()
y_np = y.to_numpy()

#scale numbers
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler

scaler = MinMaxScaler()
X_np = scaler.fit_transform(X_np)


# Train/test split
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X_np, y_np, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Convert to tensors
X_train_t = torch.tensor(X_train, dtype=torch.float32)
y_train_t = torch.tensor(y_train, dtype=torch.float32)
X_test_t  = torch.tensor(X_test,  dtype=torch.float32)
```

```{python}
#creat nural network
class BikeNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_sizes, output_size):
        super().__init__()

        layers = []
        last = input_size

        # Build hidden layers dynamically
        for size in hidden_sizes:
            layers.append(nn.Linear(last, size))
            layers.append(nn.ReLU())   # change activation here if desired
            last = size

        # Output layer
        layers.append(nn.Linear(last, output_size))

        self.model = nn.Sequential(*layers)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.model(x)
```

```{python}
#model settings
hidden_layers = [256, 128]
learning_rate = 0.005      # change learning speed
batch_size    = 64         # change batch size
epochs        = 200        # change training length

model = BikeNet(
    input_size=X_train.shape[1],
    hidden_sizes=hidden_layers,
    output_size=2
)
```

```{python}
#training loop
train_ds = TensorDataset(X_train_t, y_train_t)
train_dl = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True)

optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

for epoch in range(epochs):
    for xb, yb in train_dl:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        preds = model(xb)
        loss = criterion(preds, yb)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    if epoch % 20 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch}, Loss: {loss.item()}")
```

```{python}
#test predictions
preds = model(X_test_t)
print(preds[:5])
```

```{python}
#holdout predictions
holdout_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byui-cse/cse450-course/master/data/biking_holdout_test_mini.csv"
holdout_df = pl.read_csv(holdout_url)

#scale numbers
X_holdout = scaler.transform(X_holdout)


X_holdout = holdout_df.select(features).to_numpy()
X_holdout_t = torch.tensor(X_holdout, dtype=torch.float32)

holdout_preds = model(X_holdout_t).detach().numpy()
print(holdout_preds[:5])
```

```{python}
#format and save predictions
pred_df = pl.DataFrame({
    "registered": holdout_preds[:, 0],
    "casual": holdout_preds[:, 1]
})

pred_df.write_csv("bike-mini-holdout-predictions.csv")
```

```{python}
#combine to one column
df = pl.read_csv("bike-mini-holdout-predictions.csv")

df = df.with_columns(
    (pl.col("registered") + pl.col("casual")).alias("predictions")
)

df.select("predictions").write_csv("combined-predictions.csv")
```
